services.name: Events & Rentals
services.desc: Host your event at the Pilgrim Monument and Provincetown Museum or make plans to join us at one of ours! The recently renovated grounds of the historic Pilgrim Monument and Provincetown Museum are available to rent from May through October for outdoor weddings, private functions, corporate affairs and fundraising events. With gorgeous views of the night sky and plenty of space, the East and the West lawns are perfect for special occasions of all sizes. These spaces offer a sense of seclusion, beautiful landscaping and stunning daytime views of Cape Cod Bay and the Atlantic Ocean. services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: The Provincetown Museum is a charming mix of the old and the new, where truth meets tradition. Exhibits highlight the arrival of the Mayflower Pilgrims, the local Native American Wampanoag Tribe, the town’s rich maritime history, early days of modern American theater in Provincetown, the building of the Pilgrim Monument, the town’s enduring LGBTQ+ legacy and more. For more than six decades, Salvador R. Vasques III collected and preserved the objects, stories, photographs, signs, documents, and everyday artifacts that help tell the story of Provincetown.
